Finance workflow
fields.description: CRM finance workflow, docs/crm-finance-workflow.md. Each phase has its own switch and is off until management turns it on.

fields.label: Finance workflow (Phase 1)
fields.description: Deal links on sales orders, invoices and payments, the deal's post-sale stage, the CRM Finance tab, the New quotation dialog, the pending-approval guard and the BDE conversion report. Custom fields exist either way.

fields.label: BDE can see invoice/payment amounts
fields.description: Open question Q17. When off, salespeople without a manager or accounts role see invoices and payments on their own deals without amounts.

fields.label: Let finance roles open the CRM
fields.description: Users with one of the roles below can open the CRM and read every deal (read only), so Accounts can use the Finance tab.

fields.label: Finance roles in the CRM
fields.description: One role per line.

fields.label: CRM read rows added
fields.description: Custom DocPerm rows this setting added, so turning it off removes exactly those.

fields.label: Receivables and reminders (Phase 2)
fields.description: Receivables page, collection follow-ups, the daily reminder and escalation job (D-3, D0, D+7, D+15 draft dunning, D+30, then weekly), receivable exceptions and the daily digest. Needs Phase 1 on.

fields.label: Send reminder emails to clients
fields.description: Off until the wording, language and mailbox are agreed (open question Q14). Internal tasks and notifications run either way.

fields.label: Reminder sender
fields.description: Blank: the default outgoing account.

fields.label: Invoicing company
fields.description: Team Back Office KSA. Reminders run for this company's invoices; blank means every company.

fields.label: KSA Accounts lead
fields.description: Owns collection on a deal with no accounts owner (open question Q18); otherwise the deal owner does.

fields.label: Head - Sales & Marketing
fields.description: Notified at D+15.

fields.label: Finance Manager
fields.description: Notified at D+30 and gets the daily digest in the app.

fields.label: Daily digest recipients
fields.description: Email addresses, one per line or separated by commas.

fields.label: Allocation and transfers (Phase 3)
fields.description: India's share of each KSA receipt (TBO Fund Allocation) and the transfers that settle it (TBO Fund Transfer). A sub-ledger only: nothing is posted to the accounts. Needs Phase 1 on and the invoicing company set.

fields.label: Partner company
fields.description: Team Back Office India: receives the share.

fields.label: Allocation start date
fields.description: Receipts before this date get no allocation (Q16). Set to the deploy date on the first migrate; preview earlier receipts on the Allocations page, which records nothing.

fields.label: Accounting option (Q1)
fields.options:
Memo only
Monthly inter-company invoice
Journal Entry per receipt
fields.description: Only Memo only is built: allocations and transfers post nothing to the GL whichever option is chosen, until Finance confirms Q1.

fields.label: Base after the client's bank charges
fields.description: Off (Q5/Q6 default): the base is the amount credited to the client.

fields.label: Default VAT %
fields.description: Only for money with no invoice, order or quotation to read a VAT ratio from.

fields.label: Difference tolerance
fields.description: Transfer differences at or below this are not exceptions.

fields.label: Days before a transfer counts as pending
Reconciliation and approvals (Phase 4)
fields.description: Duplicate and amount checks on bank lines, a second person verifies each matched line, verified lines lock, unmatched lines age into exceptions, and the post-sale stage goes on to Settling, Reconciled and Closed. Needs Phase 1 on.

fields.label: Days before an unmatched bank line is an exception
Second approval above
fields.description: Open question Q5. Exceptions above this amount need a second, different approver. Blank: one approver is enough.

fields.label: Finance dashboard (Phase 5)
fields.description: Adds finance cards to the CRM dashboard by role: quotations, invoiced, collected, outstanding, overdue and lead-to-deal for CRM users (their own deals for a salesperson); payable to India, transfers waiting, bank lines to verify and open exceptions for accounts, finance and management. Needs Phase 1 on.
Used only by the smart lead features switched on below. Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.

Enforce check-in radius
fields.description: Refuse an employee's own check-in outside their allowed location: the Shift Location on their active Shift Assignment, else the list below. Does nothing until at least one location with a radius applies, so switching it on can't lock anyone out.

fields.label: Allowed check-in locations
fields.description: For employees without a Shift Assignment location. Inside any of them is allowed. Each needs coordinates and a check-in radius.

fields.label: Worst GPS accuracy accepted (m)
fields.description: A punch with a vaguer fix is refused. Up to 50 m of the reported accuracy is added to the radius.

fields.label: Roles that may check in anywhere
fields.description: One role per line (for example Field Staff). Their punches outside the radius are accepted and flagged Outside radius. For one person working from home, tick Allow remote check-in on their Employee.

fields.label: Reverse geocoding URL
fields.description: Nominatim /reverse endpoint that names the place when the phone didn't. Point it at a self-hosted Nominatim if you run one; leave empty to turn the lookup off.

fields.label: Contact email for reverse geocoding
fields.description: Sent to Nominatim with each request, as its usage policy asks.
